name: wp2
exec: (()=>{const T=window.THREE,S=window.__app.scene;let m=null;S.traverse(o=>{if(o.name==='main:dctWall')m=o;});m.updateWorldMatrix(true,false);const p=m.geometry.attributes.position;const v=new T.Vector3();const pts=[];for(let i=0;i<p.count;i+=36){v.fromBufferAttribute(p,i).applyMatrix4(m.matrixWorld);pts.push([+v.x.toFixed(0),+v.y.toFixed(0),+v.z.toFixed(0)]);}const xs=[...new Set(pts.map(q=>q[0]))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);const zs=[...new Set(pts.map(q=>q[2]))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);return JSON.stringify({distinctX:xs,distinctZ:zs})})()
